# Data land libraries 

Loaind libraries 

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets) 
library(plotly) 
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)


```
 loading data 
```{r}
get_all_inspections = function(url) {
  
  all_inspections = vector("list", length = 0)
  
  loop_index = 1
  chunk_size = 50000
  DO_NEXT = TRUE
  
  while (DO_NEXT) {
    message("Getting data, page ", loop_index)
    
    all_inspections[[loop_index]] = 
      GET(url,
          query = list(`$order` = "zipcode",
                       `$limit` = chunk_size,
                       `$offset` = as.integer((loop_index - 1) * chunk_size)
                       )
          ) %>%
      content("text") %>%
      fromJSON() %>%
      as_tibble()
    
    DO_NEXT = dim(all_inspections[[loop_index]])[1] == chunk_size
    loop_index = loop_index + 1
  }
  
  all_inspections
  
}

url = "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/43nn-pn8j.json"

nyc_inspections = 
  get_all_inspections(url) %>%
  bind_rows()

manhattan_inspection_grade = 
  nyc_inspections |> 
  filter( boro == "Manhattan", !is.na(grade)) |> #selecting manhattan restaurants
  group_by(camis)|>
        filter(inspection_date == max(inspection_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |> # selecting latest grade
  mutate(grade = as.factor(grade)) |> #transform grade into factor so it can used in plots
  select(-violation_code) |> #selecting just grade
  distinct(camis, .keep_all = TRUE) #removing duplicates
          
  

  

```

```{r}
manhattan_inspection_grade|> 
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Grade: $", grade)) |>
 plot_ly( 
    x = ~ latitude, y = ~longitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color= -grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5)
```

```{r}
manhattan_inspection_grade|> 
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Grade: $", grade)) |>
 plot_ly(
    x = ~ longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
```


```{r}
scatter_ggplot = 
  manhattan_inspection_grade|>
  ggplot(aes(x = latitude, y = longitude, color = grade)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  coord_cartesian() +

ggplotly(scatter_ggplot)


```
 
 
```{r, eval = FALSE}
data(nyc_airbnb)

nyc_airbnb = nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(rating = review_scores_location/2) |> 
  select( neighbourhood_group, neighborhood, rating, price, room_type, lat, long) |> 
  
  filter(
    is.na(rating), 
    neighborhood_group == "Manhattan", 
    room_type == "Entire home/apt", 
    price |> 100:500)
  
```




```{rr, eval = FALSE}
 nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate( 
    text_label = str_c("Price:$", price, "Rating:", rating)) |>  #so that it hovers
  plot_ly( x = ~ lat, y = ~long, 
    x = ~ lat, y = ~long, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color= -price)
```
 
 ## boxplot
 
```{r, eval = FALSE}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fact_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  plot_ly( y = ~price, color = -neighbourhood)
```


## barchart 

```{r, eval = FALSE }
 nyc_airbnb  |> 
  
  count(neighbourhood) |> 
  plot_ly( x = ~neighbourhood, y = ~n, type = "bar", color = ~neighbourhood )
```
